summary: Frontend-only review of Vinted Manager v1.2 (Backup/Restore). CRITICAL BLOCKER: the Plus tab is missing the entire 'Sauvegarde & Restauration' UI section — both testIDs `backup-create` and `backup-restore`, the section title, the two buttons, and the '💡 Crée une sauvegarde avant…' tip are absent from /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/plus.tsx. The supporting code (imports from backup.ts, onBackup/onRestore handlers, `backupItem`+`tip` styles, reloadFromStorage in context) is all correctly implemented, but the JSX that renders the section was never added, so users cannot trigger backup or restore. v1.1 regression verified OK: Dashboard, Stock, Ventes, Action, Plus tabs render without red-screen, Export CSV section still visible, footer shows 'v1.2', notifications module is web no-op (warning logged only).

ui_bugs.issue: Missing JSX for 'Sauvegarde & Restauration' section. Handlers onBackup/onRestore are defined (lines 75-127) and styles backupItem/tip are declared (lines 263-273) but never rendered. testIDs `backup-create` and `backup-restore` do not exist in the DOM. Tip text '💡 Crée une sauvegarde avant de changer de téléphone…' is also missing.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot be exercised at all because the two trigger buttons are not rendered. buildBackup/exportBackup/pickBackupFile/applyRestore in /app/frontend/src/utils/backup.ts look correct (web uses Blob+anchor download; isValidPayload checks app==='vinted-manager' + arrays; merge by id; replace overwrites AsyncStorage; reloadFromStorage refreshes UI state after restore).

After adding the JSX, re-run tests to cover: (a) backup-create triggers a .json download on web (filename vinted-manager-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json), (b) backup-restore opens the web <input type=file> document picker, (c) invalid JSON → 'Fichier invalide' alert, (d) valid JSON → 3-button alert (Annuler/Fusionner/Remplacer) and UI reflects imported data after reloadFromStorage.
critical_code_review_comments: plus.tsx: handlers, imports and styles were added but the UI block wiring them is missing. This is the entire v1.2 feature UI — looks like a paste was truncated. Add the JSX block between the MENU map and 'Export CSV' SectionTitle.

backup.ts: uses `expo-file-system/legacy` — intentional to keep writeAsStringAsync/readAsStringAsync API; fine for SDK 54+. Web branch builds a Blob and clicks an anchor — correct for forcing a download. isValidPayload correctly guards non-VM JSON.
context.tsx: new `reloadFromStorage` is correctly wired and used by the restore handler so state refreshes post-import without a page reload — good design.

notifications.ts: scheduleWeeklyBackupReminder is web-noop (early-return on Platform.OS==='web'). No crash on web verified; uses CalendarTriggerInput with weekday/hour/minute — appropriate for iOS/Android.
plus.tsx imports `applyRestore` but it is only called inside onRestore, which is itself never invoked because the restore button is missing — dead import at runtime until JSX is added.
Minor: the description 'stock.length article' uses s-plural but '0 article' shows singular — cosmetic only.

success_rate.frontend: 0% for v1.2 feature (UI missing); 100% for v1.1 regression

seed_data_creation: None — could not proceed beyond UI check because the backup UI is absent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent adds the JSX for backup-create/backup-restore buttons + tip text in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/plus.tsx, re-run: (1) viewport 375x667, open https://4baf622a-f5cb-4cb5-b7cd-e29e7dccddf9.preview.emergentagent.com, navigate to Plus tab, assert `[data-testid="backup-create"]` and `[data-testid="backup-restore"]` exist. (2) Intercept window.URL.createObjectURL and HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click BEFORE clicking backup-create to capture the Blob content without a real download; verify filename matches /^vinted-manager-backup-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\.json$/ and parsed JSON contains keys {version:1, app:'vinted-manager', exportedAt, stock, ventes, clients, retours, niches}. (3) For restore flow on web, the `expo-document-picker` renders an <input type=file> — use page.set_input_files to feed a crafted invalid JSON (expect 'Fichier invalide') and then a valid payload (expect 3-button alert). Note Playwright can only intercept JS alerts via page.on('dialog'), but React Native's Alert on web uses window.alert/confirm — listen for 'dialog' events and accept/dismiss to exercise Fusionner/Remplacer branches. (4) After Remplacer, verify stock tab shows the imported items.
rca_of_issue: Missing UI for v1.2 backup/restore. RCA: in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/plus.tsx the author added (a) imports from ../src/utils/backup, (b) onBackup/onRestore handlers, (c) styles.backupItem and styles.tip, and (d) updated footer to v1.2 — but forgot to add the JSX block that renders the SectionTitle + two TouchableOpacity buttons (testID backup-create, backup-restore) + the tip Text. Reproduction: open Plus tab → only Sourcing/Niches/Clients/Retours cards + Export CSV + Réinitialiser are visible; no 'Sauvegarde & Restauration' section, no backup buttons, no tip. Mitigation: add the JSX snippet shown in action_items between the MENU.map(...) and the <SectionTitle title="Export CSV" …/> lines. The backing code is already in place so only JSX is needed.
